name: corpus.card
description: DRAFT — per-card classification for the 853 Recall cards (Mike's full Recall corpus). The state carries CARD_TITLE (recall card top line) and CARD_SOURCE (domain, channel, or publisher). Routes the card into a RIG lane and assigns an action. Counting, ordering, dedupe and final disposition stay in code; only the typed judgment is asked here. The pilot phase scores 10 cards; the full pass runs only after Mike signs off the rubric and the pilot verdicts agree with ground truth.

lane_fit.instructions: Which RIG lane does this card primarily serve? Pick the one lane where the card's claim would be acted on this quarter. If it cuts across lanes equally, pick general.

criteria.rig_build: RIG OS, agents, harnesses, deviation engines, Memory OS, ProofPackets, model routing
criteria.gtm_buyer: RIG B2B marketing, sales, cold outreach, lead gen, pipeline
criteria.client: work that lands on a client's account/reputation (Ideawake/Coby or similar)
criteria.jacob: athletic, recruiting, NIL, content about Mike's 15-year-old son — CHILD LANE, treat as sensitive
criteria.general: cross-cutting, frameworks, philosophy, or none of the above

rig_overlap.instructions: How much does this card overlap with a RIG capability, skill, doctrine, or routine that already exists? Novel means: at least one named claim in the card is not covered by any current RIG asset. Partial: the card extends an existing capability with new evidence. Duplicate: the card's core claim is already stated somewhere in RIG (skill, doctrine, kanban card, Memory OS note).

criteria.novel: at least one named claim is new to RIG
criteria.partial: extends an existing RIG capability with new evidence
criteria.duplicate: core claim already stated in a RIG asset

evidence_density.instructions: How concrete is the card's evidence? Specific_code means a real repo, file path, CLI command, or named API. Specific_pattern means a named framework, formula, gate, score, or rubric. Practitioner_argument means a named person advancing a thesis with reasons. Opinion_listicle means tips, hacks, motivational advice, or generic frameworks without specifics. News_summary means recent events, releases, or product news.

criteria.practitioner_argument: named person, named thesis, with reasons

actionability.instructions: If this card is real and worth RIG's time, what is the cheapest action that captures its value tonight? Extract_skill means a SKILL.md file can be authored from this card in one sitting. Doctrine_update means an existing skill/doctrine should be patched with the card's claim (point at which file). Watch_only means it informs thinking but does not produce a RIG artifact. Skip means below threshold (wrong, redundant, low-quality, or off-brand).

criteria.extract_skill: a new SKILL.md can be authored tonight
criteria.doctrine_update: an existing file should be patched
criteria.skip: below threshold — wrong, redundant, low-quality, off-brand

anti_generic_force.instructions: How far does this card deviate from 'median AI / median business advice' output? 0 = pure median, says what every other channel says. 1 = slight angle, not distinctive. 2 = has a unique angle worth a paragraph. 3 = has a named mechanism, formula, or pattern not seen elsewhere. 4 = exceptional — near-twin of the seed doctrine, would shift a published position. 5 = category-defining — should re-pin the seed.
criteria: 4: exceptional — would shift a published RIG position

rules.reason: below threshold; do not import, do not act on
duplicate of an existing RIG asset; differentiation routes via anti_generic_force.score per bar
Lane C — content about Mike's 15-year-old son; child-safety rules apply, requires per-card Mike approval before any action
Client lane — work lands on another person's account/reputation; requires Mike's per-card approval
actionability answer distribution is not concentrated
overlap answer distribution is not concentrated
deviation score answer distribution is not concentrated

notes.bar: Nouls/choices pass only when confidence above 0.9. anti_generic_force.score is consumed by code: score >= 3 with actionability in (extract_skill, doctrine_update) routes to import; score < 2 routes to watch_only.

downstream_actions.extract_skill_with_score_ge_3: candidate for SKILL.md authoring tonight; surface in nightly build-card digest
downstream_actions.doctrine_update_with_score_ge_3: candidate to patch an existing skill/doctrine; surface as a queue item with the target file
downstream_actions.watch_only_with_score_ge_2: candidate for Memory OS as a reference note; tagged anti-generic but not actionable
downstream_actions.skip: do not import; record the skip reason for the audit
downstream_actions.jacob_or_client: do not auto-route; queue for Mike's per-card approval

notes.planted_failure_required: Must BLOCK a card whose actionability is 'skip' AND must ESCALATE a card whose lane_fit is 'jacob' even when other answers look clean. Pilot will include one of each planted to prove the gate fires.
notes.open_question_for_signoff: Should 'anchored to a RIG project' artifact in the actionability.choice be a separate 'project' lane in lane_fit, or stay folded into rig_build? Mike's call.
